title: Pro-étale higher direct images of abelian sheaves commute with filtered colimits
statement: Let $f\colon X\to Y$ be a quasi-compact [def-weil-finite-type-morphism] and quasi-separated [def-weil-quasi-separated-morphism] morphism of schemes and $f_*$ the direct image of abelian sheaves on the small pro-étale sites [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site]. Then for every $q\ge0$ the right derived functor $R^qf_*$ [def-sfb-right-derived-functor] preserves filtered colimits [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit]: for a filtered diagram $(K_i)$ of abelian sheaves on $X_{\mathrm{pro\acute et}}$ the canonical map $\varinjlim_iR^qf_*K_i\to R^qf_*(\varinjlim_iK_i)$ is an isomorphism.
